_comment: STM pipeline configuration for Clean module. Defaults: receipt_mode + direct_mode active. Used for receipt artifact cleanup and code comment normalization. Source: G0DM0D3 PAPER §3.5, WabbleSpec-adapted.

receipt_mode.purpose: Strip first-person language from receipt artifacts; capitalize status tokens

direct_mode.purpose: Remove sycophantic preambles from generated code comments and doc strings

hedge_reducer.note: Disabled for Clean — hedge reduction is Polish scope, not Clean scope

spec_mode.note: Disabled for Clean — spec artifacts are Polish scope

scope_restriction: receipt artifacts and code comments only — Clean never applies STM to production code logic
